_how_to_edit: Update this file weekly (GitHub web editor works). 'week_of' is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) used to show a freshness label. 'deals': funding rounds in your own words; 'category' is one of: Venture, Private Equity, Funds, People, IPO, Exit, M&A. 'videos' need only a URL (YouTube title auto-fetches); 'articles' need a title + url. Save = site auto-redeploys.
